how_to_apply: Register on the RITES website in the registration format under the Tab "Career" → Expert Registration → Registration for Consultant/Expert.

Fill in the proforma in Annexure-A, giving the Vacancy Circular No., the position, your qualifications, your last organisation, designation and grade pay, your last basic pay and grade (CDA/IDA pay scale), your experience and your vigilance status.

Complete the Annexure-B self declaration. It confirms that no vigilance or CBI case, disciplinary proceeding or prosecution proceeding is pending against you, and that you have no penalty of the kind barred by the notice.
Email the generated registration document to Shri Narendra Mohan Soy, DGM/Civil at [email protected] with the subject line "Application for the post of ............ VC No ..../26(E)".
Attach Annexure-A, Annexure-B and the documents below to the same email, and send it within 20 days from the date of publication.
High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth
Service Certificate and Last Pay-slip, indicating last grade and basic pay drawn, issued by the last employer
PF No with the last employer
Proof of Identity & Address (Passport, Voter ID, Driving License, Aadhaar Card etc)
Proof of different periods of experience as claimed in the Application Form (if applicable)
Any other document in support of candidature

content_sections.heading: About RITES
content_sections.text: RITES Limited is a Navratna Enterprise of the Government of India, with its Corporate Office in Gurugram and its Registered Office in Delhi. These positions serve its Maintenance Services for the dedicated test track between Gudha and Thathana Mithri stations of the Jodhpur Division of North Western Railway.

rows.post: Asstt. Team Leader (TRD & OHE), VC No. 77/26(E)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Allowances
content_sections.text: The remuneration shall be fixed at 50% of the last basic pay drawn at the time of superannuation. Transport Allowance, as applicable, is paid in addition. Re-engaged employees are not entitled to increment, Dearness Allowance or House Rent Allowance.

content_sections.heading: RITES Assistant Manager Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: Maximum 64 years as on 30 November 2026. Those imposed any major penalty during the last 10 years of service, or a minor penalty during the last 05 years of service, are not eligible to apply. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Place of posting: Nawa City, District Didwana-Kuchaman, Rajasthan. The appointment is purely on contractual basis, initially for one year. It is extendable until completion of the assignment, subject to mutual consent and satisfactory performance. The actual deployment will be subject to fulfilment of requirements. faq.question: Q1. Can a retired official from outside the Railways apply?
faq.answer: Yes, for VC No. 76/26(E), 77/26(E), 82/26(E), 83/26(E) and 84/26(E), which accept non-Railway superannuated officials with the stated maintenance experience. VC No. 78/26(E) to 81/26(E) ask for retired Railway officials of the Civil engineering department.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts accept a Diploma?
faq.answer: Assistant Manager (TRD&OHE) and Asstt. Manager (S&T) ask for a Diploma in Engineering from a recognised institution. The first accepts Electrical, Mechanical or Electronics, and the second accepts Electrical or Electronics.

faq.question: Q3. How much experience does a non-Railway candidate need for an Assistant Team Leader post?
faq.answer: A minimum of 10 years' experience is required, in rail track maintenance for P-Way or TRD maintenance for TRD & OHE. At least 5 of those years must be at executive level.

faq.question: Q4. Will I receive Dearness Allowance or House Rent Allowance?
faq.answer: No. Re-engaged employees receive neither of these, and they also get no increment. Transport Allowance is the only addition to the remuneration, as applicable.

faq.question: Q5. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: The contract initially runs for one year. It can be extended until the assignment is complete, if both sides agree and performance is satisfactory.

faq.question: Q6. What should the email subject line say?
faq.answer: Use "Application for the post of ............ VC No ..../26(E)", filling in the post name and its VC number.

faq.question: Q7. Which document proves my date of birth?
faq.answer: The notice asks for the High School certificate as proof of Date of Birth.

faq.question: Q8. What happens if my name appears in an Agreed or Secret list?
faq.answer: Under the Annexure-B declaration, your engagement may be terminated forthwith without any prior notice.
